preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n+1 lines, where the first line is the integer n and the subsequent n lines are hashtags.
The number of hashtags n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(line.startswith('#') and len(line) > 1 and all(c.islower() for c in line[1:]) for line in lines[1:])
preconditions.description: Each hashtag line starts with '#' followed by at least one lowercase English letter.
The total length of all hashtags (excluding the '#' character) does not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines, one for each input hashtag.

postconditions.expression: all(out_lines[i].startswith('#') and out_lines[i][1:] in input_hashtags[i][1:] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid hashtag derived from the corresponding input hashtag by deleting a suffix (keeping the '#' and a prefix of the original text).

postconditions.expression: all(out_lines[i] <= out_lines[i+1] for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: The sequence of output hashtags is sorted in non-decreasing lexicographical order.

postconditions.expression: sum(len(input_hashtags[i]) - len(out_lines[i]) for i in range(n)) == min_deleted
postconditions.description: The total number of deleted characters is minimized among all valid solutions that satisfy the lexicographical order constraint.
